members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: value
members.doc: The number, when the caller controls it. NaN keeps the field empty.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting number, when the field controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new number each time it is committed, and with NaN when the field is cleared.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its number stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: minValue
members.doc: The smallest value. A typed value below it is raised to it when committed.

members.name: maxValue
members.doc: The largest value. A typed value above it is lowered to it when committed.

members.name: step
members.doc: How much the steppers and arrow keys change the value, and the step a typed value is rounded to when committed.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named field submits the plain number, or an empty string while it is empty.

members.name: formatOptions
members.doc: How the number is shown, as Intl.NumberFormat options such as currency or percent. It changes only the displayed text: the field reports and submits plain numbers.
